theme: known numerical system and record representation
status: completed published-source replication and synthetic controls; independently checked
question: Which positional and physical membership information supports a numerical relation and decoder?
outcome: Published UR068-to-UR067 alignment matches 16/20 columns with absolute error 16; ordered flattening with known width reproduces it. It is the unique minimum among 400 relative shifts; 10,000 shuffles and 10,000 bag allocations have minimum errors 738 and 828. Complete simulations recover hidden positional values in 299/300 worlds, with one positive ambiguity. All 36,000 prefix states and 20,411 source predictions were independently checked.
challenge: Pendant positions and knot-cluster totals are all zero in selected database fields. Source review exposed target quantities before protocol freeze. Removing grouping and misassigning membership produce different ambiguities or failures.
remedy: Pinned six original accounts and separated markers and CM009 reconstruction; used the published source alignment with disclosed prior exposure and an isolated scorer. Separate generated accounts have quantity-hidden inputs, exact positive solution certificates and later-relation evaluation.
retry_when: Measured cluster intervals, a documented new source relation, or a fresh observation-error/robust-decoder design changes the input. Reuse the current endpoints for the published fixed alignment.
